confirmation.source: User request: move both side towers toward the Core exactly one tile and make all other cards as detailed as Dart Gun

mechanicNotes: Guard Towers: horizontal centers move from ±7.76 to ±6.76 tiles on both teams. Exact inward movement: one tile (125 world units). Core centers, tower depth, bridge positions and arena dimensions are unchanged.

All other card models receive fitted, character-specific anatomy, armor, clothing, weapon and mechanical detail; card art is rendered from the upgraded in-game models. Dart Gun is preserved as the visual reference.
All 22 playable card definitions and the subordinate skeleton definition retain their complete 1.9.0 stats and abilities. No audio changes.
Navigation revision13 distinguishes the new tower positions in Meta simulations and recorded mechanics snapshots.
